title: The conformally invariant metric on CLE$_4$ I: subsequential limits of the non-simple CLE graph metric
summary: We consider the conformal loop ensemble (CLE) with the parameter $κ=4$, the critical value at or below which the loops are simple and do not intersect each other or the domain boundary. We show that the loops of a CLE$_4$ uniquely determine a conformally invariant, local, and geodesic metric so that the metric ball growth from the domain boundary coincides with the uniform exploration of Werner and Wu.
